items.description: Signed CB A.J. Woods to the practice squad.
Signed DB Elijah Jones and WR Scotty Miller to the practice squad. Released DB Deantre Prince from the practice squad.

Designated QB Dillon Gabriel and DT Kalia Davis to return from injured reserve. Signed WR James Proche and DT Chris Williams to the practice squad. Released RB Eric Gray and P Wes Pahl from the practice squad.
Placed LB Edgerrin Cooper on injured reserve. Signed LB Kristian Welch to the active roster. Signed RB Damon Bankston to the practice squad.
Signed OL Chandler Zavala, LB Chase Wilson and DB Derrick Canteen to the practice squad.
Signed WR Quez Watkins to the practice squad. Released CB Elijah Culp from the practice squad.
Signed LB Eric Kendricks to the practice squad.
Signed DE Eric Watts to the practice squad. Released DE Amari Gainer from the practice squad.

Placed G Donovan Jackson on injured reserve. Signed OT Tristan Leigh to the practice squad. Released CB Natrone Brooks, P Johnny Hekker and RB Devin Neal from the practice squad. Waived CB Tyreek Chappell from injured reserve.
Released OL Jose Ramirez. Signed CB Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad. Released OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon from the practice squad.
Signed WR Dontae Fleming to the practice squad.
T Lane Johnson announced his retirement.

Signed TE Teagan Quitoriano from the practice squad to the active roster. Placed LT Paris Johnson Jr. and TE Hunter Long on injured reserve. Signed TE Kenny Yeboah, OL Austin Deculus and S Mark Perry to the practice squad. Released OL Vershon Lee and CB D'Shawn Jamison from the practice squad. Signed OL Jedrick Wills Jr..
Signed CB Terell Smith from Washington's practice squad to the active roster. Signed LB K.J. Henry to the practice squad. Released LB Bradyn Swinson from the practice squad.
Signed OT Daniel Brunskill to the practice squad. Released DL Jordan Jefferson. Designated FB/DL Scott Matlock and OL Branson Taylor to return to practice.
Signed DL Viliami Fehoko Jr. to the practice squad.
Signed RB Robert Henry Jr. from Washington's practice squad to the active roster. Waived S AJ Finley. Placed RB Jacardia Wright on the practice squad/injured list.
Signed CB Brandon Johnson to the practice squad.
Signed CB Jaylon Jones and CB Alijah Huzzie to the active roster. Placed S Caleb Ransaw on injured reserve. Waived CB Christian Braswell with an injury designation.
Designated G Tyler Smith to return from injured reserve.
Waived RB Carlos Washington Jr.
Waived WR Jeshaun Jones.
Signed CB Sean Murphy-Bunting to the active roster. Signed LB Marte Mapu to the practice squad. Waived DB Doneiko Slaughter. Placed DT Derrick Harmon on injured reserve.
Elevated DB Te'Cory Couch and CB Kani Walker.
Placed LT Braxton Jones on injured reserve. Elevated DE Marcus Davenport and CB Nick McCloud from the practice squad to the active roster.
